question: Is the 0.8m horizontal-clearance failure isolated to one S10 pose, or do the three sealed C08 trajectories contain systematic ineligible route segments?
method: Read all 4773 sealed C08 poses without early stopping; cast 720 world-horizontal rays at 0.5-degree spacing from each frozen sensor origin; preserve minimum hit distance/azimuth and evaluator-only edge/tunnel identity; merge consecutive frames below the unchanged 0.8m threshold into risk segments.
baseline: Compare against the prior connector-only geometry contract and the failed causal replay that stopped at the first ineligible frame. Necessary fallback is evidence-backed geometry/trajectory redesign after this audit; no threshold relaxation or frame deletion is permitted.

user_authorization.scope: One complete 4773-pose/3,436,560-ray C08 clearance-only audit; zero inference, graph, training, C09/C10 and M-TARE.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the exact proposed clearance audit and exclusions.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 worlds, 3 trajectories and all 4773 frames are audited without early stopping, using exactly 3,436,560 horizontal rays.
Every frame preserves finite minimum clearance, hit azimuth, pose, route arc, edge/tunnel identity and threshold outcome; every failed frame belongs to exactly one complete consecutive risk segment.
Three per-world summaries report pass/fail counts, minimum and p01/p05/p50/p95 clearance; six complete scientific previews show all trajectories and all failures.
Inference, graph updates, training samples, C09/C10 and M-TARE reads all equal zero; complete logs, metrics, artifacts, environment/tool/input hashes and evidence seal are retained.
Audit PASS denotes complete diagnostic evidence and does not require all frames to exceed 0.8m.
stop_conditions: Any graph, mesh, geometry parameter, trajectory, traversal, code or config hash drifts.
Any frame lacks a finite nonnegative horizontal hit, frame/ray count is not exact, risk segmentation loses a failed frame, or evidence cannot be sealed.
Any inference, graph construction, training, C09/C10/M-TARE read, threshold change or frame deletion would occur.
expected_evidence: One complete 4773-row frame clearance CSV and four risk-segment JSON files.
Three world metrics and aggregate/runner summaries.
Three complete XY/XZ risk maps and three clearance-versus-route plots.
Raw log, frozen config/data card, environment/tool/input hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D only; 3,436,560 horizontal rays, expected minutes; zero GPU.
